  WHY: No post-move timing exists, and shards ran 15.0-17.1 minutes on passing runs and 20.2 minutes on overruns. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT (headroom risk only, handled by budget-watch), gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR.
